scope: Read-only helper/source/retained-image review. No simulator, process, build, UI device command, source/helper edit, or external resource action performed. Active device tests left untouched.
reviewedSkill: Repository-local validate-hang-ten-ios/SKILL.md and runtime/validation documentation consulted for explicit device ownership and actual visual verification requirements; this audit does not execute validation.

retainedEvidence.wholeImage: before.png reviewed in full: normal Train, visible Wood Grips Compact II board, settings button and normal navigation; no system alert visible.
retainedEvidence.interpretation: Matching application PID with zero frame and empty children is an inconclusive AX observation. It is not evidence that Train controls are absent, that the app is blocked, or that a dialog exists. This preflight image is not proof of the board selected in later arm launches.

Train.fact: Requires train.settings and expected train.board AX nodes before capturing Train setup screenshot; an empty tree aborts despite a visible normal UI.

URL.fact: Open/Cancel AX nodes decide whether a consent tap occurs; no screenshot is taken at the actual consent boundary. Empty AX cannot prove no alert.

workout.fact: Requires AX routinePicker node; empty AX can abort even if normal workout is displayed.

Mini.fact: Hand selector/menu/Left idle/Start are setup-only AX gates; coordinate-based physical tap fallback can be bound to fresh reviewed actual controls.

sourceBoundary.fact: DEBUG board review flag selects catalog board at initialization; verify literal board name in fresh Train screenshot rather than assuming flag success.
Normal onOpenURL routes production deep link to Train/workout.
Normal auto-start occurs when plan does not require hand choice; screenshot/setup review delay can consume initial countdown/hang.
Normal menu contains Left hand; user hand choice stays editable only before first Start.
Normal primary control calls toggleRunning; no review autostart or renderer preparation bypass is needed.

smallestFreshSetupRecommendation.protocol: New uniquely named arm, same normal app launch through all setup stages and measurement. Preserve original failed runtime-evo and all former helper bytes/proofs. Retain AX stdout as diagnostic evidence; replace only its required setup-control assertions with fresh whole-image root review when AX is empty.
smallestFreshSetupRecommendation.Train: Immediately capture whole Train image after existing launch wait. Root verifies actual normal Train, arm expected board name and absence of obstructing modal. Bind acknowledgement to screenshot SHA, exact UID/app PID, current source/parity/binary SHA and stage nonce. No guessed controls or inherited previous-launch UI facts.
smallestFreshSetupRecommendation.consent: Open production workout URL once, retain command start/end, then capture fresh full screen at consent checkpoint. If actual Cancel/Open alert is visible, root identifies Open in that fresh image and a physical tap occurs exactly once. Prefer AX label when available; otherwise record fresh visible-control point and authoritative screenshot-to-logical-point/orientation mapping. If no alert is visible and actual workout is already visible, explicitly record physicalOpenCount0. Unknown/partial alert or ambiguous control fails without tap/retry. Empty AX alone does not choose either branch.
smallestFreshSetupRecommendation.EvoPro: Immediately capture route checkpoint after observed consent handling or direct route. Establish external measurement anchor at that screenshot command completion and begin unchanged fixed-offset screenshots while root reviews the checkpoint passively. Route review failure invalidates the arm; it does not authorize UI correction/backfill. Record this prospective anchor change, since prior helper used final AX command completion. Root review does not infer app phase/time from anchor.
smallestFreshSetupRecommendation.Mini: Normal route screenshot must show idle Start and real hand selector. Root reviews fresh screen then physical hand-selector tap once, captures actual menu and verifies Left hand before physical Left hand tap once. Capture fresh left-selected idle screen and require visible Left hand + Start. Tap actual visible Start once and anchor at that command completion. From this anchor only screenshots; validate actual running/countdown later from whole images.
smallestFreshSetupRecommendation.afterAnchor: Exactly the retained58 scheduled screenshots, original fixed offsets/lateness bound, no AX, tap, gesture, pause, Skip, relaunch, or synthetic state forcing. Whole-image setup review is passive host image review, not a device query.

boundedReviewImplementation.acknowledgements: Helper writes immutable stage image/manifest and waits for an explicit root-written acceptance JSON bound to stage nonce/image SHA/UID/app PID. Root is operator already authorized by task; no additional user confirmation is needed.
boundedReviewImplementation.bounds: Use an aggregate setup deadline that leaves the existing224-second capture window within the300-second helper lifetime, or declare a new setup/lifetime bound before execution and update wake assertion coherently. Never extend or reset the deadline silently. Check acknowledgements in short bounded intervals; a missing/mismatched/rejected acknowledgement fails with retained artifacts and exact cleanup.
boundedReviewImplementation.autoStartConstraint: Do not block Evo/Pro capture waiting for root route-image review after workout appears: initial10-second Hang can elapse during review. Begin passive schedule immediately at route checkpoint, allow root to accept/reject while it runs, and mark failed if acknowledgement is absent by predeclared bound. Earlier setup-stage acknowledgements can block while Train/URL consent is still idle.
boundedReviewImplementation.coordinatePolicy: Coordinates target only visible ordinary UI buttons/menu choices from fresh setup screenshots, never board geometry. Derive scale/orientation from device/screenshot metadata; record mapping and chosen point. Do not reuse stale preflight coordinates or hardcode a guessed dialog placement.
